title: Registration-only wait can mistake a results replacement race for deterministic oversized artifacts
outcome: Keep a transient results stamp/read replacement race distinct from an oversized artifact within the existing wait/disk owner, preserving bounded grace and typed UNKNOWN semantics.
acceptance: A results.json that disappears between its pre-read stamp and read receives the existing transient-read grace instead of being inferred TooLarge solely because results_stamp is present; an actually oversized result retains deterministic no-grace UNKNOWN behavior.

Deterministic fixture coverage distinguishes the stamp/read disappearance race from oversized request/results and ordinary published-loss behavior without adding polling, a queue, a lifecycle owner or verification credit.
